lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs3Au crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. A geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both Au and Cs centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors at a uniform distance of 3.6792 Å. The Au centers are surrounded by 12 Cs neighbors, while Cs centers have 4 Au and 8 Cs neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Cs–Cs 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, with Au–Cs pairs sharing edges.
